name: WeChatBridge
use_label: Forward WeChat chats to AI agents
one_liner: A Mac app that sends WeChat chat history to an AI agent or Obsidian straight from WeChat's forward menu.

text.why: Since macOS WeChat 4.1.13 you can merge-forward several chats to another app, but only apps with a share extension appear in that list. WeChatBridge fills that gap so one forward lands in Codex, Claude, Obsidian and more.
text.take: It builds a path out of WeChat on top of WeChat's own forward menu, which is the practical part.
build: A native macOS app that receives WeChat's forwarded bundle (a ZIP of text, images and video) and hands it to the targets you enable — Codex, Claude, Doubao, Qwen and others — with everything processed on your own machine.

who.role: Mac users who work over WeChat and want those conversations summarised by AI or kept in their notes.

start.text: Install the notarized DMG from GitHub Releases, enable the targets in the app, then pick chats in WeChat and merge-forward them.

caveat: macOS only, and needs macOS WeChat 4.1.13 or later. The app and docs are Chinese-first, though the README has an English version.

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
